title: SAE Feature Completeness Probe: What Fraction of Known Concepts Are Recoverable?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If SAEs miss a substantial fraction of known concepts, they cannot serve as complete safety monitoring tools. Quantifying this gap directly motivates better training objectives and calibrates expectations for SAE-based safety interventions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: No GPU training required, only SAE inference via SAELens on pre-trained GPT-2-Small SAEs. Compiling known concepts from prior probing studies is a literature review task. Activation correlation measurement is straightforward. Very accessible for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 20 concepts, one model, one SAE, one metric (concept recall rate). The main work is curating the concept list and computing correlations. No training, no custom model work. Clear deliverable as a recall rate table. Fits 30 hours easily.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
